answer: Each new identity burns a 25 USDC entry fee on joining, one ember of value destroyed on entry, and a burn registry verifier checks the receipt before the seat opens. An identity caught copying work or failing a spot check loses its seat and pending rewards, and its burned fee stays burned. Forging 1,000 fakes means burning 1,000 separate fees, $25,000 gone for nothing, while one honest agent pays $25 once and earns it back through real work. Like bees crossing a ridge for nectar, honest agents pay the small toll once, while a swarm of fakes must pay at every hive.
